_note: One completed Company DNA intake, used as the fixed input for the determinism test, the golden-artifact test and the HTTP happy path. Deliberately EXERCISES the refusals rather than avoiding them: hard_disqualifiers carries one lawful requirement and one that rests on a protected attribute, so the compiled artifact has both an accepted and a refused entry in it and the golden file would notice if either stopped being produced.
headcount_growth_stage: Six hundred people, growing about fifteen percent a year, Series D and profitable in two of three markets.
industry_regulatory: Regulated fintech. RBI oversight on the payments business and PCI DSS across the card estate.
locations_work_model: Bengaluru and Pune are hybrid three days on site. The Singapore team is fully remote.
attrition: About eighteen percent, and it concentrates in engineers between their second and fourth year.
time_to_hire: Forty five days for an engineer and closer to ninety for a manager, measured rather than targeted.
interview_capacity: Two panels per role per week, and that is the real ceiling rather than an aspiration.
observable_behaviours:
Has taken a project from an unclear brief to a shipped outcome and can describe the decisions they made when nobody told them what to do.
Has moved a blocking function such as compliance or legal to a decision without holding authority over it, and can describe how they got there.
Has taken an unpredictable team to a predictable delivery cadence and can describe the mechanism they introduced.
Has rewritten a system that was already carrying traffic and can describe how they cut over without an outage.
Has caught a defect in their own work before a customer did and can describe what they changed afterwards.
failed_hires:
Two strong individual contributors we promoted into manager roles stalled when they had to negotiate with a function that did not report to them, and both left within a year.
One senior engineer delivered nothing for a quarter because nobody handed them a defined process, and they never asked for one.
statutory_requirements: Background verification before an offer, and a valid work authorisation for the country of employment.
notice_tolerance: Up to ninety days for a manager, sixty for everyone else.
compensation_bands: Published internally by level, with about ten percent of flexibility at the top of each band.
location_rules: Relocation is supported for Bengaluru and Pune. The Singapore roles cannot be relocated into.
hard_disqualifiers:
Must hold a valid CA licence for the finance controller roles
No candidates over 45
interview_stages: A screen, a working session, a panel and a hiring manager conversation.
client_run_assessments: We run our own take-home for backend roles, so please do not duplicate it.
turnaround_commitments: Feedback within three working days of every stage.
slate_goals: At least one third of every sourced slate from under-represented groups, measured at sourcing and never at scoring.
data_receivable: The assessment report, the resume and the interview transcript. No raw proctoring footage.
consent_language: Our standard candidate data notice, shared before the first assessment.
retention_period: Eighteen months after the application closes.
cross_border: Singapore candidate data stays in Singapore and is not copied into the India estate.
band_vs_market: We sit at about the sixtieth percentile for engineering and at market for everything else.
counter_offer_patterns: Counter offers are common from the two largest local competitors and usually arrive after the offer is signed.
target_industries: Payments, banking infrastructure and regulated marketplaces.
talent_pools: Engineers who have shipped under an audit regime, and managers who have run a team through a compliance review.
past_hire_outcomes: We can supply three years of hires with their first-year outcomes and the dimension each failure sat on.
